title: ChannelForge Local Channel Configuration
description: Shape contract for data/lineup/locals.json. This validates structure only (required/optional fields and types). It intentionally does not enumerate specific stations, networks, or markets — those vary per deployment and are not a structural concern.

_comment.description: Optional documentation note. Ignored by any reader of this file.

number.description: Real/virtual channel number for this local station.

network.description: Network affiliation, e.g. 'CBS'. Not restricted to a fixed list of networks.

display.description: Human-readable display name combining the fields above.
